description: The Market Core of the Eclipse Markets suite (spec eclipse-markets-suite-spec-20261025): one canonical Instrument / Book / Quote / Order / Position / Resolution model over exchanges and prediction markets, with venue adapters that translate and never improvise. Resolution criteria are stored verbatim and hash-pinned — a venue criteria edit is a CRITERIA_CHANGED event and positions keep the criteria as of entry. Quotes carry all-in buy/sell cost for a stated size from versioned, provenance-stamped fee schedules; a stale or missing schedule degrades all-in fields to FEE_UNVERIFIED rather than quoting a wrong number. Resolutions move REPORTED -> VERIFIED only against the criteria's own named source (DISPUTED is first-class), and no core output ever carries a probability field — outputs carry price + liquidity flag + depth + verbatim criteria. M0 is data only: no accounts, no keys, no order submission at any tier; order_draft is an unsubmitted record whose mandate pre-evaluation is honestly NOT_EVALUATED until the owner-gated M2.
